what: Stanley Black & Decker makes power tools and hand tools under DeWalt, Craftsman, Stanley and Black+Decker, plus outdoor equipment and engineered fastening systems for carmakers and manufacturers.
customers: Professional tradespeople, home improvement retailers, industrial manufacturers and consumers.
money: power tools, hand tools, storage and outdoor equipment
engineered fastening for automotive and industrial customers
moat: DeWalt's position with professional tradespeople, where battery platforms lock users into one brand's tools once they own the batteries.
risks: Revenue has fallen about 4% a year over three years
Operating margin of about 3% is far below its historical level
Tariffs on tools manufactured in Asia raise costs directly
opportunities: A dividend yield above 3% with a very long record of increases
A large cost reduction and supply chain programme is intended to restore margins
A recovery in housing and renovation would lift professional tool demand
watch: Gross margin recovery and organic revenue growth in Tools and Outdoor.
